verdict.rationale: New Relic's alerts docs say any signal can be evaluated 'against a threshold, or if it exhibits abnormal behavior,' which covers the core of alerting on anomalies without hand-written thresholds. AI insights also surface potential issues in workload health. Support rests on a single short first-party line, so depth is unclear. Missing for 10: details on how anomaly/outlier detection is configured and how sensitive it is, explicit outlier-detection evidence, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
